provenance: Terrain Effects Modifiers (rule 11.1) and Infantry Movement Costs (rule 5.5): transcribed from the data card image described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md section 7.4.

The stone building modifier is not visible on that image. Its value +3 comes from the rulebook text: the rule 17.5 example says units in a building hex on board 1 receive the +3 modifier of the building, and the rule 3.8 example gives +3 for a two-terrain hex.
Movement costs are stored in half movement factors so that the rules stay in integer arithmetic (NFR-05). A road entered from a road hexside costs one half.
LOS classes come from rule 7.2 (woods and building symbols block) and rule 44 (wheatfields, Scale). Slice 1 records the wheat hindrance count only; the modifier waits for rule 44.
The project writes these rows in its own layout. No card text or card layout is reproduced (SR-07).

open.note: Open ground, non-moving 0. Moving in open ground is -2 in the Defensive Fire Phase (rules 11.3, 16.5), applied by rule 16, not by this row.

shellhole.note: Shellhole +1, 1 MF (rule 44.31). Rule 44.32: a unit fired on while it moved through a shellhole takes minus one and not the minus two of rule 16.5.

wheat.note: Wheatfield 0, 1 MF. Rule 44.21: a unit sees into a wheatfield hex and not through it. Fire that goes through one is half strength as Area Fire, and a height advantage takes that away. Rule 44.23 keeps the minus two of rule 16.5 off a unit that moved in one. Rule 44.24 makes the crop seasonal, and out of season the hex is open ground.

wooden_building.note: Wooden building +2, 2 MF to enter and 2 MF for each hex inside. Blocks LOS (rule 7.2).

stone_building.note: Stone building +3 (rule 17.5 example), 2 MF to enter and 2 MF for each hex inside. Blocks LOS (rule 7.2).

road.note: Rule 11.4: the other terrain in a road hex decides the terrain effects on combat.

wall.note: Rule 11.2 and 11.53: +2 when the LOS crosses the wall into the target hex. The value comes from the rulebook appendix example for 11.5, which gives a net +5 as +2 wall plus +3 stone building. The data card image gives +1 for a hedge. Rule 11.51: the LOS may cross a wall hexside only if it ends or originates in the hex that the hexside forms, or with a height advantage. Movement: 1 MF plus the cost of the terrain entered.

hedge.note: +1 from the data card image. The LOS and movement rules are the same as a wall (11.5).

cliff.note: Rule 44 (Scale). Movement across a cliff hexside is not allowed.
